title: Calibration
description: Constants the engine needs that are not benchmark rows: tokenizer ratios, cache pricing, hidden context factors, and the output to input energy weight.

exact.description: True when we run the provider's own encoding, so no ratio is applied.

cachedReadShareOfInput.description: No provider publishes the energy cost of a cache hit. The low bound is zero on purpose.

outputToInputEnergyWeight.description: How much more energy an output token costs than an input token. Used to split a per prompt figure.

derivedRowWidening.description: Multipliers applied to low and high when a per token rate was derived rather than measured.

assumedTokenCountWidening.description: Extra widening when a per prompt row did not publish its token counts.

hiddenContextFactor.description: Web apps hide their system prompts and retrieved context, so counted input is a lower bound. Keyed by surface.

localPue.description: Facility overhead for a model running on your own machine. There is no data centre, so this sits at one.

parametricWidening.description: Multipliers for a rate that came out of a formula rather than a measurement. Wider than derivedRowWidening because the formula's unit convention is not fully pinned down; see the dataset changelog.
